roles.patientDesc: Consult doctors, keep your health records and find medicines nearby.
roles.sahayakDesc: Village health assistant who helps patients consult doctors with a digital health kit.
roles.doctorDesc: Consult rural patients remotely, review vitals and write prescriptions.

landing.title: Arogya Sahayak
landing.subtitle: The village doctor, at home
landing.tagline: Rural healthcare made simple. Consult doctors with the help of your local Sahayak, keep your health records safe and find medicines nearby, all in your own language.
landing.featureConsultDesc: Video, voice or chat with qualified doctors, or join a consultation at your Sahayak's health centre.
landing.featureMedicinesDesc: See which nearby pharmacies have your medicine in stock, and at what price, before you travel.
landing.featureRecordsDesc: Prescriptions, vitals and lab reports in one place, shared only with your care team.
landing.step1: Visit your Sahayak or sign up
landing.step1Desc: Your local health assistant registers you and checks your vitals with a digital kit.
landing.step2Desc: A doctor joins by video, voice or chat and reviews your vitals in real time.
landing.step3Desc: The prescription is saved to your records and you can find the medicines nearby.
landing.footer: Making healthcare accessible to rural India.
landing.ctaDesc: Create an account in a minute, or visit your nearest Sahayak to get started.
